summary: Grupo Aeromexico filed a 6-K furnishing a September 14, 2026 press release calling an Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting for October 26, 2026 in Mexico City, the local equivalent of an annual/special shareholder meeting notice. The sole substantive agenda item seeks approval of the maximum resources the company may allocate to repurchasing its own shares under the Securities Market Law, plus appointment of special delegates. No price, stake, premium, advisor or recommendation is stated. Routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch for any buyback authorization size.
